BadRequest.description: Invalid request parameters or body. Returned either for a specific application-level error, or for a failed request validation (in which case `message` is the underlying Joi validation message, e.g. "\"title\" length must be at least 3 characters long"). Possible application-level messages include: Missing article photo; Invalid user id; Invalid article id; Invalid id format; No file provided; Image is too complex to compress below 1 MB; Email in use; Invalid file type. Only JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP are allowed.; File is too large. Maximum upload size is 10 MB.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid authentication. Possible messages include: Missing access token; Session not found; Access token expired; Missing tokens; Session token expired; Invalid credentials; Unauthorized.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to perform this action. Possible message: Forbidden.

NotFound.description: Resource not found. Possible messages include: Article not found; User not found; Route not found.
